Name: Luny's Witch Hats for Fashion Sense
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
These hats were designed around my hairstyles from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24746]Luny's Hair Salon[/url], but should fit with most similar hairstyles too.

Contains:
1 witch hat that's plain with no decorations.
1 witch hat with a flower crown.
1 witch hat with a flower crown and trim along the brim.

The hat, flower crown, and trim can be dyed separately for great customization!


To install:
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]!
Unzip the file and drop the folder into StardewValley/mods. Done!


If you'd like to support my mods, [url=https://ko-fi.com/looneyluny]consider buying me a coffee[/url]. Don't feel obligated though. (￣▽￣*)ゞ I'll also be accepting commissions there in the future!
